task.description: Repeated unit increments stop after steps or at cap; any equivalent terminating implementation is allowed.

methods.name: Refill
methods.header:
method Refill(used: int, steps: int, cap: int) returns (next: int)
  requires 0 <= used <= cap && steps >= 0
  ensures next == (if used + steps <= cap then used + steps else cap)

strategy: Generate code satisfying the fixed input. Decide your own tool actions.
